note: Sanitized aggregates only: category names, function counts and byte totals. No addresses, bytes or disassembly. Every figure carries a basis, 'measured' (counted on the pinned image by a local script) or 'estimated' (a stated heuristic). This file feeds the progress image; it does not change the scope totals in data/progress.json, which stay null.

ghidra_functions.method: Ghidra headless import of the pinned image, findings/ghidra-import.md.

exported_function_entries.method: Function entries in the local export used by the later census scripts, docs/resource-guidelines.md.

functions_excluding_funclets_and_thunks.method: Export entries minus 67,896 exception-handling cleanup funclets and 1,616 import thunks, docs/resource-guidelines.md. Includes middleware and generated initializers.

ordinary_game_code.method: Functions in .text$mn whose nearest vftable-labelled neighbour is an engine class. Other estimates: 68,000 to 78,000 functions, 15.4 to 17.2 MB, docs/resource-guidelines.md.

categories.label: Ordinary game code
categories.method: Nearest vftable-labelled neighbour in .text$mn is an engine class; neighbourhood heuristic, upper end counts some std-labelled neighbourhoods.

categories.label: Havok
categories.method: Nearest vftable-labelled neighbour is an hk* class. A 256 KiB window method gives about 7,600 functions, findings/community-resources.md.

categories.label: Scaleform
categories.method: Nearest vftable-labelled neighbour is a GFx class; most Scaleform code has no RTTI so this is a lower bound of at least 800 by the window method.

categories.label: Bethesda.net client
categories.method: Nearest vftable-labelled neighbour is a bnet class. Window method: about 2,900 functions.

categories.label: std and CRT
categories.method: Nearest vftable-labelled neighbour is a std or Concurrency class.

categories.label: Static initializers
categories.method: POGO section group .text$di of the image.

categories.label: Static teardown
categories.method: POGO section group .text$yd of the image.

categories.label: EH funclets
categories.method: Functions named Unwind@ or Catch@, emitted with their parent function.

categories.label: Other
categories.method: Remainder of the 106,486-function denominator after the groups above (.text, .text$mn$00 and unclassified).

structure_census.note: Decodable by the comparator is a structure census, not a match claim.

primary_unwind_entries.method: Comparator census over the .pdata entries that begin in code; supplied by the orchestrator and not re-run here.

blocks.label: C++ exception handler
blocks.method: Non-funclet functions with a language handler, 95,395 unwind-map entries and 714 try blocks, docs/resource-guidelines.md.

blocks.label: No language handler
blocks.method: Remaining non-funclet functions: 106,489 minus 39,848 with a handler.

blocks.label: EH funclets
blocks.method: Decoded through their parent's unwind data.

jump_table_candidates.method: Functions with a register-indirect jump, docs/ideas-next.md.
